summary.json.scope: Private Node scratch initialization and sized-range index-width experiments; no production edits
summary.json.memory_safety_review: Node remains trivially copyable. Empty constructor affects only buffer resize before all radix output writes. Every active pass fully initializes output before pointer swap; inactive passes never read scratch. buffer_=nodes_ initializes full second array before solve. Vector ownership and exception cleanup unchanged. Input nodes use full constructor.

decision: 添字圧縮・初期化省略を採用。abs省略のmod2^64二乗案はGCC native random/sortedで約2–4%後退し不採用。標準65bit表現への常時切替はGCCで大きく後退し不採用。以前検討したSIMD leafは他条件の後退を改善できておらず未採用。
limits: 公式大規模で約1–9%短縮、格子系約1–2%。一部小中規模は約1–1.5%後退。4096 syntheticの一部も約1%後退。小入力の後退を避けるため添字圧縮を2048以上に限定。

prepare.py.source:
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(__file__).parent
s=Path('/tmp/sirkit_nearest_ready_20261024/current.hpp').read_text()
(p/'current.hpp').write_text(s)
noinit=s.replace('        std::size_t index;\n    };','        std::size_t index;\n        Node() noexcept {}\n        Node(std::int32_t a, std::int32_t b, std::size_t i) noexcept : x(a), y(b), index(i) {}\n    };')
assert noinit!=s
(p/'noinit.hpp').write_text(noinit)
for name,body in [('compact',s),('compact_noinit',noinit)]:
 body=body.replace('class NearestTwoPointsSolver {','template<class Index>\nclass NearestTwoPointsSolver {')
 body=body.replace('std::size_t index;', 'Index index;')
 body=body.replace('solver.nodes_.size()});','static_cast<Index>(solver.nodes_.size())});')
 body=body.replace('NearestTwoPointsSolver::run(std::move(first), std::move(last))','NearestTwoPointsSolver<std::size_t>::run(std::move(first), std::move(last))')
 body=body.replace('NearestTwoPointsSolver::run<true>(std::move(first), std::move(last))','NearestTwoPointsSolver<std::size_t>::run<true>(std::move(first), std::move(last))')
 for is_sorted in [False,True]:
  r='return reinsirk::detail::NearestTwoPointsSolver<std::size_t>::run'+('<true>' if is_sorted else '')+'(std::move(first), std::move(last));'
  c='reinsirk::detail::NearestTwoPointsSolver<std::uint32_t>::run'+('<true>' if is_sorted else '')+'(std::move(first), std::move(last))'
  assert r in body
  body=body.replace(r,'if constexpr (std::sized_sentinel_for<Sentinel, Iterator>) {\n        const auto n = last - first;\n        if (n >= 0 && std::cmp_less_equal(n, std::numeric_limits<std::uint32_t>::max()))\n            return '+c+';\n    }\n    '+r)
 (p/(name+'.hpp')).write_text(body)
(p/'bench.cpp').write_text(Path('/tmp/sirkit_nearest_ready_20261024/bench.cpp').read_text())

reproduction: frozen_rootを/tmp/sirkit_nearest_online_20261024、frozen_agentを/tmp/sirkit_nearest_layout_20261024へ復元。前回ready監査のcurrent.hpp/current_main.cppとofficial保存入力を同一hashで用意する。bench.pyとfinal_official_perf.pyを実行。CPU番号は環境に合わせる。
